text: This is the Wall of blacktongue.
Its signature Cent, number 5185,
was struck in 1968,
and carries a full desert patina and a ghost.
The Wall holds twenty-four Cents,
from 1938 to 1980.
Among them is one of only two Cents from 1938.
And one of nine with a full gold patina.
That gold, with five other Cents,
completes a Full Spectrum Set:
a full verdigris, a full obsidian,
a full red, a full desert,
a full gold and an orange.
Only nine Full Spectrum Sets can exist,
as there are only nine Full Gold Cents.
On 24 October 2026, two Walls held one:
this Wall, and the wallet
of the artist, Rutherford Chang.
Across its Cents, the Wall also
covers four of the twelve contamination
types, which makes a Contamination Set.
